title: Chattajack 2026 · regional context
notes: A fixed, partial snapshot of race-morning observations retrieved on October 24, 2026. It is not live weather. Later race-hour observations have not been verified. Airport wind and visibility do not describe every part of the gorge.

water.forecast: The organizer anticipated water temperatures in the low 70s °F. This is a forecast, not a measured race-day temperature.

river.notes: Chickamauga Dam releases provide river context for this course. Race-hour discharge and river level have not been verified. Dam discharge is a volume rate, not current speed at the canoe; release effects also take time to travel downstream.
